title: Account Recovery Bypass Code (Internal)
summary: This internal guide instructs agents how to process an Rho-Bank “Account Recovery Bypass Code” during identity verification: confirm the complete code matches 9K2X7M4P1N8Q3R5T6A, log it via log_verification (name/user_id/address/email/phone_number/date_of_birth set to that code), and set time_verified to the actual timestamp before proceeding.
faqs: What should I do when a customer provides an Account Recovery Bypass Code?
What exact bypass code must I verify it matches (and what if it doesn’t)?
How do I record the bypass code using the log_verification tool (which fields and what values)?
When should I set the time_verified field, and what timestamp should it reflect?
Can I enter customer personal details when using a bypass code?
What documentation/communication rules apply (e.g., not reading the code aloud; where the code may appear)?
